title: Tighten and fit a loose necktie
instruction: Finish the loose necktie: snug the knot, slide it up to the collar using the narrow blade, and leave both blades neat with your hands clear. The collar form is rigid plastic; there is no person.
context: Adjusting a necktie is a familiar dressing skill and a useful form of assistance for someone with limited hand movement.
setup: A 1.26 m woven polyester tie, 70 mm wide at the wide end, 35 mm at the narrow end and about 1.2 mm thick, starts in a loose, already-threaded Simple knot on a rigid collar form. The knot is 74 mm wide and 57 mm high, its top 81.5 mm below the collar edge and centre 25 mm to the left. Both blades hang vertically, with the short narrow blade behind the wide one. A 110 mm-diameter, 100 mm-high plastic neck has two 50 × 55 × 8 mm collar flaps on a steel stand. Both YAM hands start open. README and the reset diagram specify all coordinates and preparation.
scoring: Judge after both hands release for 5 seconds. Award 0.5 if the intact threaded knot is at most 70 mm wide and high, with its top within 60 mm below the collar edge. Full credit also requires its top within 20 mm, its centre within 20 mm of the collar mark, the wide blade flat within 30 degrees of untwisted, its tip 350–440 mm below the collar edge, and the narrow blade behind it, within 15 mm laterally and with its tip at least 10 mm higher. Otherwise 0. Pulled-out ends, damaged fabric or added support score 0. Use front/rear photos, video and a ruler.
fidelity: Reduced model of a loose, already-threaded tie. A wide-blade pull against a held knot snugs the wrap; a separate narrow-blade hold allows the knot to slide up. Length is conserved. Finite finger-volume grasps and a disclosed 3 N sliding-resistance approximation apply opposing loads to the native arms. Released blades drape approximately. Internal folds, arbitrary rethreading and detailed textile contact are omitted; parameters are uncalibrated. This tests finishing and fitting, not tying from scratch.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 in 1,200 actions; scripted demo: 1.0 in 810 actions. Both independently rescored from measured native hand poses.
reset_notes: Prepare the loose Simple knot using the threading diagram. Set the 25 mm lateral offset and stated knot dimensions; both blades hang straight, with the narrow blade behind the wide one, outside any keeper loop. Use the same tie and preparation for every trial. Remove all hands and supports before starting; replace damaged fabric. No clips, pins, tape or hidden support. README gives fixed dimensions and an ordinary ruler check.
